context_notes: Phase 45 money-path waves (45-03/05/06/07/08 + FIX1/FIX2) plus 45-09 gift-card split-tender are all deployed to prod (image sha256:5ec14723 after F3). This session was a LIVE controlled UAT on the standalone kiosk (kiosk.js) -> prod Railway -> live Helcim terminal + Zoho, store closed, on the owner's own card. KEY LESSON repeated from the prior incident: F1's code and its unit mocks agreed on a fictional Apps Script response key ('balance') that never occurs in prod ('current_balance') — mocks mirroring an invented shape gave false green. Derive mock shapes from a real captured response/contract, not from the code under test. Manual-confirm is the safe recovery for an orphaned terminal charge (books-only, idempotency-guarded). Full UAT detail in 45-09-UAT-FINDINGS.md.
